items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: with our writing we’ve become friends

ctx.x: Well this has been a fascinating talk, and you know I think next time we run into each other at one of these parties we should do this again.

Oh you’ll hear the same. There’s so many things. You know Bill Challis. I made a friend. I wanted to see him, when he died. This is Bill Challis‘ 75th birthday. That’s not on the machine? We’re off it?
No we’re still going, that’s okay.
